evals.name: pr-review-skill
evals.prompt: evals/files/targets/pr-review.md はうちのチームのPRレビュー用スキル。これを使わせると「仕様を確認しました、問題ありません、LGTM」みたいな返事ばかりで、本当に確認したのか分からない。スキルを改善して。改善後のスキル全文も出して。
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that maps each instruction to the output, flags the spec/impact/test/edge-case instructions whose results are not left in the review, keeps the no-write/no-push rule, and an improved skill whose review must contain related spec, impact, test results with unverified items, and the verdict with its grounds.
expectations: The evaluation classifies each of the target's steps 1-7 and its caution note by how its result reaches the output (対応あり / 対応が不十分 / 対応なし / 行動指示を維持, or an equivalent distinction)
「関連する仕様書を確認する」「変更の影響範囲を調査する」「テストが通ることを確認する」 are identified as instructions whose results are not left in the review
「十分に」 and 「漏れなく」 are flagged as requirements whose fulfilment cannot be judged, and replaced by information that can be checked (scope covered, scope left out, reasons)
The rule not to rewrite the files under review or commit/push is treated as an action instruction to keep, and it is still present in improved-skill.md
improved-skill.md asks the review to contain, besides test results, the behaviour the tests do not cover (unverified items) and why
improved-skill.md lets the review tell apart 'checked and nothing found', 'not checked' and 'cannot judge'
improved-skill.md asks the review to contain the verdict (merge or not) and its grounds
improved-skill.md does not fix the investigation procedure or the answers (no mandated files/chapters to read, tools to use, or fixed wording to output)

evals.name: incident-skill
evals.prompt: evals/files/targets/incident-investigation.md の障害調査スキル、出てくる報告が毎回薄くて、後から見返しても何を調べて何を調べてないのか分からない。改善して、直したスキルの全文もちょうだい。
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that flags 「漏れなく」 and the action-only steps, calls the fixed four-heading/3-line format an over-constraint, keeps the production and PII rules, and an improved skill whose report must contain evidence, facts vs inferences, ruled-out causes and what could not be checked.
expectations: The evaluation classifies each of the target's steps 1-5, its report format and its two cautions by how the result reaches the output (or an equivalent distinction)
「影響範囲を漏れなく把握する」 is flagged as vague, with a replacement that states what was checked and what was not
The fixed format (only four headings, at most 3 lines each) is flagged as an output constraint that can drop needed information, and a looser alternative is proposed
「本番環境に対してコマンドを実行しない」 and 「顧客の個人情報を書かない」 are treated as instructions to keep, and both are still present in improved-skill.md
improved-skill.md asks the report to give the evidence (log lines, change history) for the root cause it names
improved-skill.md asks the report to keep facts apart from inferences
improved-skill.md asks the report to state what could not be checked (for example missing logs) and not to treat unchecked as fine
improved-skill.md asks the report to name the candidate causes that were ruled out and why

evals.name: aidoc-restraint
evals.prompt: ../aidoc-less-is-more/SKILL.md のスキル、AIが本当にやったかを後から確かめられる書き方になってる？まず評価だけして。ファイルは変えないで。
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that recognises the skill's report section already carries most results, proposes only a few targeted changes (for example the results of re-reading the core in step 9 are not reported), keeps the stop-and-confirm and ask-first rules, and leaves the file unchanged.
expectations: The evaluation recognises that the skill's 報告 section (declaration, results per kind, QA result, machine-check counts, Jaccard) already carries the results of many steps, and classifies those steps as already corresponding to the output
It recognises places that already separate 'none' from 'not checked' (for example 「0件と書く」, 「元文書が曖昧と記録する」) and does not propose adding duplicate requirements for them
It treats the procedural or safety instructions (ask when no target is given, stop for the declaration check, announce what will be overwritten) as instructions to keep
It points out that the result of at least one verification step that is not in the final report (step 9 core re-read or step 10 duplicate re-check) does not reach the output
It proposes only a few targeted changes and does not rewrite the whole skill or add a large new report format
Every change it proposes quotes the instruction, states the problem, and gives the conversion
The input file is unchanged
